correct_diagnosis: Type 2 diabetes mellitus inadequately controlled on metformin, with established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease
matching_criterion: Type 2 diabetes mellitus not at glycaemic target on metformin, with established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (prior myocardial infarction). Any wording that names inadequately controlled type 2 diabetes with cardiovascular disease counts as correct.

management_reference.management: Add a second agent with proven cardiovascular benefit: an SGLT2 inhibitor or a GLP-1 receptor agonist, because of established cardiovascular disease.
management_reference.source_quote: in case of high risk for CVD, or renal issues, one can choose the best out of the SGLT2i and GLP1-RA

management_reference.management: Continue metformin as first-line background therapy.
